fields.Name: T38 - Data Explorer Search Courses
fields.Description: Verifies that the Courses entity grid search/filter box narrows results to courses matching a term.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K global search) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree open the 'Courses' entity. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then use the grid's own search/filter box (within the Courses grid, not the global Ctrl+K search) to search for 'Food Safety'. Success is reached when the grid filters down to matching course(s), such as 'SAF-101 Food Safety Fundamentals'.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Courses entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A search/filter term of 'Food Safety' has been entered into the grid's search box
The grid shows at least one matching course containing 'Food Safety' (e.g. 'SAF-101 Food Safety Fundamentals')
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
